description: Collibra Four Letter Code (FLC) manifest for the singine man page pipeline. Governs silkpage sidebar metadata extraction, man page generation, PostgreSQL migration, and Mule→SpringBoot service migration. 1-year mandate contract.
sbvr_rule: Every Man Page must be traceable to exactly one Sidebar Metadata entry governed by a Four Letter Code from this manifest.

flc_codes.label: Man Page
flc_codes.description: Generated roff man page sourced from silkpage sidebar metadata. Published under man/singine-*.1.
orm_facts: Man Page is sourced from exactly one Sidebar Metadata
Man Page has one or more Data Citizens as contributors
Man Page is governed by exactly one Governance Contract

flc_codes.label: Sidebar Metadata
flc_codes.description: Silkpage XML navigation entry (<tocentry>) plus page <head> metadata (title, summary, keywords).
orm_facts: Sidebar Metadata is extracted from exactly one Silkpage Asset
Sidebar Metadata provides source for zero or more Man Pages

flc_codes.label: Content Block
flc_codes.description: Silkpage XML section element (<section id="...">). Each section becomes a man page .SH entry.
orm_facts: Content Block belongs to exactly one Sidebar Metadata
Content Block corresponds to exactly one .SH section in a Man Page

flc_codes.label: Data Citizen
flc_codes.description: Community-active data citizen with a public identity ID. Linked to man pages as author, contributor, steward, or reviewer.
orm_facts: Data Citizen has a unique public citizen_id
Data Citizen participates in one or more Man Pages
Data Citizen is bound by one or more FLC mandates

flc_codes.label: Migration Service
flc_codes.description: Record of a Mule→SpringBoot service migration. Linked to the man page documenting the migrated service.
orm_facts: Migration Service migrates from exactly one source technology
Migration Service migrates to exactly one target technology
Migration Service may reference a Collibra contract ID

flc_codes.label: Governance Contract
flc_codes.description: 1-year mandate contract codified in Collibra. The contract_id c.contract.man-pipeline-1yr governs all FLCs in this manifest.
orm_facts: Governance Contract governs one or more FLC Codes
Governance Contract has a mandate_start and mandate_end
Governance Contract is registered in Collibra community

flc_codes.label: DW Dimension
flc_codes.description: Data warehouse dimension. All FLC codes are mapped to dimensions (main/primary/secondary/n_linear/relational/boolean/temporal).
orm_facts: DW Dimension maps to exactly one FLC Code
DW Dimension has exactly one axis (time/subject/operation/data-citizen)
DW Dimension participates in the category ontology (V003)

flc_codes.label: Singine Execution
flc_codes.description: Singine runtime command execution. singine man generate triggers a SNGE record in the audit log.
orm_facts: Singine Execution is initiated by a Data Citizen
Singine Execution produces zero or more Man Pages
Singine Execution is logged in GOV-001 audit trail

flc_codes.label: Silkpage Asset
flc_codes.description: Silkpage publication page. The HTML output served at singine.uk. Source for SIDM sidebar metadata.
orm_facts: Silkpage Asset contains one or more Content Blocks
Silkpage Asset has exactly one Sidebar Metadata entry in the TOC

flc_codes.label: Mule Service
flc_codes.description: MuleSoft ESB API/integration endpoint. Source technology in Mule→SpringBoot migration.
orm_facts: Mule Service is the source of exactly one Migration Service record
Mule Service exposes one or more HTTP endpoints

flc_codes.label: Spring Boot Service
flc_codes.description: Spring Boot microservice. Target technology in Mule→SpringBoot migration.
orm_facts: Spring Boot Service is the target of exactly one Migration Service record
Spring Boot Service replaces exactly one Mule Service

dw_dimension_mapping.description: Every FLC must be mapped to at least one DW dimension. Dimensions follow V003 categories ontology.

mule_to_springboot_services.description: Collibra REST proxy — routes singine collibra commands to api-vlab.collibra.com
ID generation HTTP server (port 7331) — currently Python; target Spring Boot REST
CDN proxy for cdn.example.org → Spring Boot static asset service
